selection: Expand source-supported economic families using all-data source archives and primary issuer publications. Select source availability and legal evidence before viewing new liquidity coefficients; retain all attempted studies irrespective of sign. Preserve original four-family estimates.
candidate_extensions: IFRS: Canadian reporting issuers with explicit first IFRS financial-statement publications, actual release dates, pre-adoption share identity and U.S.-GAAP bank comparisons.
Mandatory E/S/G: European first statutory nonfinancial statements, legal-scope self-declarations, historical share identity, actual report-release evidence.
Climate/governance/extractive extensions only if distinct legal obligations, first actual report years and adequately evidenced comparisons can be established.
main_weights: GDP allocated over fixed source-study country issuer universe; equal family and pre-event market-cap family across economic families. Equal issuer / issuer-cap alternatives. Banking phases never double-counted.
minimum_support: 3treated/20comparison; sparse selected case studies remain descriptive. No thresholds relaxed after inspecting outcomes.
controls: Known not yet/directly required through endpoints; unknown does not mean no. Contemporary accounting/filing evidence required where available. Subsidiary exposure and industry differences retained as limitations.
inference: Preserve shared issuer sampling covariance; few legal waves do not establish causal policy p-values. Broad geographic panel remains separate.
first_dates: Separate statutory/reporting-year dates, actual public release, earliest observed restatement information and first mandatory statements. No PDF metadata/signature substituted for publication.
